form.label: Routes
form.description: The jumps a permitted flow has actually been seen to make: from a declared entry point to a host, from that host onward, and what is listening where it lands.

search.query: | `riskability_fw_edges` | stats count AS edges | append [| inputlookup riskability_netevidence_lookup | stats count AS ledger, count(eval(coverage_state="no firewall data")) AS nofw] | stats max(edges) AS edges, max(ledger) AS ledger, max(nofw) AS nofw | eval edges = coalesce(edges, 0), ledger = coalesce(ledger, 0), nofw = coalesce(nofw, 0) | eval state = case(edges == 0 AND (ledger == 0 OR nofw == ledger), "unconfigured", edges == 0, "empty", 1=1, "ready")

| `riskability_fw_edges` | lookup riskability_hostaddr_lookup address AS src_ip OUTPUT hostname AS rk_s, claimants AS rk_sc | lookup riskability_hostaddr_lookup address AS dest_ip OUTPUT hostname AS rk_d, claimants AS rk_dc | where isnotnull(rk_s) AND isnotnull(rk_d) AND rk_s != rk_d AND mvcount(rk_s) == 1 AND mvcount(rk_d) == 1 | where coalesce(tonumber(rk_sc), 1) <= 1 AND coalesce(tonumber(rk_dc), 1) <= 1 | stats count BY rk_s, rk_d | append [| inputlookup riskability_netevidence_lookup | where observed_grade IN ("confirmed observed", "historically observed") | stats count BY hostname | eval rk_d = hostname, rk_s = "__entry__" | fields rk_s, rk_d] | eval hop = if(rk_s == "__entry__", 1, 0) | eventstats values(eval(if(hop == 1, rk_d, null()))) AS h1 | eval hop = if(hop == 0 AND isnotnull(mvfind(h1, "^" . rk_s . "$$")), 2, hop) | eventstats values(eval(if(hop == 2, rk_d, null()))) AS h2 | eval hop = if(hop == 0 AND isnotnull(mvfind(h2, "^" . rk_s . "$$")), 3, hop) | eventstats values(eval(if(hop == 3, rk_d, null()))) AS h3 | eval hop = if(hop == 0 AND isnotnull(mvfind(h3, "^" . rk_s . "$$")), 4, hop) | eventstats values(eval(if(hop == 4, rk_d, null()))) AS h4 | eval hop = if(hop == 0 AND isnotnull(mvfind(h4, "^" . rk_s . "$$")), 5, hop) | where hop > 0 | stats max(hop) AS maxhop | eval maxhop = coalesce(maxhop, 1) | eval labels = "c0:entry point" | eval labels = labels . ",c1:hop 1" . if(maxhop >= 2, ",c2:hop 2", "") . if(maxhop >= 3, ",c3:hop 3", "") . if(maxhop >= 4, ",c4:hop 4", "") . if(maxhop >= 5, ",c5:hop 5", "") | eval labels = labels . ",c" . (maxhop + 1) . ":software listening,c" . (maxhop + 2) . ":open findings" | table labels

div.b: No firewall data source has been configured, so there are no routes to draw.
div.span: This page draws the jumps a permitted flow has been seen to make, from the firewall's own logs. Nothing here is measured on the hosts, so without a firewall source the app cannot say anything about the network and shows nothing rather than guessing. Exposure on the other pages is unaffected: it is measured from how each process bound its socket.

An administrator configures the source in Riskability Configuration, Firewall data source: the index and field names, and the entry points (the internet, an admin network) that a route can start from. Until then every Network evidence row reads unknown, which is correct.

div.b: A firewall source is configured, but it yielded no permitted edges in the last 30 days.
div.span: Either the source holds no permitted flows yet, or the field mapping does not match the events. An administrator can run Test source on the Firewall data source page to see which. Nothing is drawn until an edge exists, because an empty graph and a quiet network look the same.

panel.title: Possible jumps, as the firewall has seen them

search.query: | inputlookup riskability_netevidence_lookup | where observed_grade IN ("confirmed observed", "historically observed") | eval rk_entry = mvindex(split(coalesce(entry_text, "entry point"), " "), 0) | search rk_entry=$entry_filter|s$ | stats sum(sessions) AS rk_v, values(rk_entry) AS rk_entries, values(protocols_text) AS rk_proto BY hostname, port | mvexpand rk_entries | eval src = rk_entries, dst = hostname, hop = 1, rk_v = coalesce(rk_v, 1), rk_proto = coalesce(mvindex(rk_proto, 0), "tcp") | fields src, dst, hop, port, rk_v, rk_proto | append [ | `riskability_fw_edges` | lookup riskability_hostaddr_lookup address AS src_ip OUTPUT hostname AS rk_src_host, claimants AS rk_src_claim | lookup riskability_hostaddr_lookup address AS dest_ip OUTPUT hostname AS rk_dst_host, claimants AS rk_dst_claim | where isnotnull(rk_src_host) AND isnotnull(rk_dst_host) AND rk_src_host != rk_dst_host | where mvcount(rk_src_host) == 1 AND mvcount(rk_dst_host) == 1 | where coalesce(tonumber(rk_src_claim), 1) <= 1 AND coalesce(tonumber(rk_dst_claim), 1) <= 1 | stats sum(sessions) AS rk_v, values(protocol) AS rk_proto BY rk_src_host, rk_dst_host, port | eval src = rk_src_host, dst = rk_dst_host, hop = 0, rk_proto = coalesce(mvindex(rk_proto, 0), "tcp") | fields src, dst, hop, port, rk_v, rk_proto ] | eventstats values(eval(if(hop >= 1, dst, null()))) AS rk_h1 | eval hop = if(hop == 0 AND isnotnull(mvfind(rk_h1, "^" . src . "$$")), 2, hop) | eventstats values(eval(if(hop == 2, dst, null()))) AS rk_h2 | eval hop = if(hop == 0 AND isnotnull(mvfind(rk_h2, "^" . src . "$$")), 3, hop) | eventstats values(eval(if(hop == 3, dst, null()))) AS rk_h3 | eval hop = if(hop == 0 AND isnotnull(mvfind(rk_h3, "^" . src . "$$")), 4, hop) | eventstats values(eval(if(hop == 4, dst, null()))) AS rk_h4 | eval hop = if(hop == 0 AND isnotnull(mvfind(rk_h4, "^" . src . "$$")), 5, hop) | where hop > 0 | eventstats max(hop) AS rk_maxhop | eval rk_hostfilter = $host_filter|s$ | eval rk_keep = if(rk_hostfilter == "*" OR rk_hostfilter == "", 1, 0) | eventstats values(eval(if(dst == rk_hostfilter, src, null()))) AS rk_anc1 | eventstats values(eval(if(isnotnull(mvfind(rk_anc1, "^" . dst . "$$")), src, null()))) AS rk_anc2 | eventstats values(eval(if(isnotnull(mvfind(rk_anc2, "^" . dst . "$$")), src, null()))) AS rk_anc3 | eventstats values(eval(if(isnotnull(mvfind(rk_anc3, "^" . dst . "$$")), src, null()))) AS rk_anc4 | eventstats values(eval(if(src == rk_hostfilter, dst, null()))) AS rk_des1 | eventstats values(eval(if(isnotnull(mvfind(rk_des1, "^" . src . "$$")), dst, null()))) AS rk_des2 | eventstats values(eval(if(isnotnull(mvfind(rk_des2, "^" . src . "$$")), dst, null()))) AS rk_des3 | eval rk_anc = mvappend(rk_anc1, rk_anc2, rk_anc3, rk_anc4), rk_des = mvappend(rk_des1, rk_des2, rk_des3) | eval rk_on_chain = if(rk_keep == 1, 1, if(dst == rk_hostfilter OR (isnotnull(mvfind(rk_anc, "^" . dst . "$$")) AND (src == rk_hostfilter OR isnotnull(mvfind(rk_anc, "^" . src . "$$")) OR hop == 1)) OR src == rk_hostfilter OR isnotnull(mvfind(rk_des, "^" . src . "$$")), 1, 0)) | where rk_on_chain == 1 | lookup riskability_exposure_lookup hostname AS dst, port OUTPUT package AS rk_pkgs | eval rk_portnode = dst . ":" . port | eval rk_edge_label = rk_proto . "/" . port . " · " . rk_v . " sessions" | eval src_kind = if(hop == 1, "0:entry", (hop - 1) . ":host"), dst_kind = hop . ":host" | eval rk_rows = mvappend(src . "|" . src_kind . "|" . dst . "|" . dst_kind . "|" . rk_v . "|" . rk_edge_label, dst . "|" . dst_kind . "|" . rk_portnode . "|" . hop . ":port|" . rk_v . "|") | fields rk_rows, rk_portnode, rk_maxhop, hop | mvexpand rk_rows | append [ | inputlookup riskability_netevidence_lookup | where observed_grade IN ("confirmed observed", "historically observed") | fields hostname, port | append [| `riskability_fw_edges` | lookup riskability_hostaddr_lookup address AS dest_ip OUTPUT hostname AS hostname, claimants AS rk_c | where isnotnull(hostname) AND mvcount(hostname) == 1 AND coalesce(tonumber(rk_c), 1) <= 1 | stats count BY hostname, port | fields hostname, port] | dedup hostname, port | eval rk_hostfilter = $host_filter|s$ | where rk_hostfilter == "*" OR rk_hostfilter == "" OR hostname == rk_hostfilter | lookup riskability_exposure_lookup hostname, port OUTPUT package AS rk_pkg | mvexpand rk_pkg | where isnotnull(rk_pkg) AND rk_pkg != "" | eval rk_portnode = hostname . ":" . port | join type=left hostname, rk_pkg [ | inputlookup riskability_findings_state_lookup where status="open" | rename package AS rk_pkg | lookup riskability_aiverdicts_lookup cve_id OUTPUT priority_tier AS rk_tier | eval rk_tier = coalesce(rk_tier, "P" . case(severity=="critical", 1, severity=="high", 2, severity=="medium", 3, 1=1, 4)) | eval rk_kev = if(isnotnull(kev_added) AND kev_added != "", 1, 0) | eval rk_epss = coalesce(tonumber(epss), 0) | eval rk_exploit = case(rk_kev == 1, 5, rk_epss >= 0.5, 4, rk_epss >= 0.1, 3, rk_epss >= 0.01, 2, 1=1, 1) | stats dc(cve_id) AS rk_cves, min(rk_tier) AS rk_top, max(rk_exploit) AS rk_exploit_rank BY hostname, rk_pkg ] | eval rk_cves = coalesce(rk_cves, 0), rk_exploit_rank = coalesce(rk_exploit_rank, 0) | eval rk_class = case(rk_cves > 0 AND rk_exploit_rank >= 4, "exploitable", rk_cves > 0 AND rk_top IN ("P0", "P1"), "critical", 1=1, "") | eval rk_pkg_label = case(rk_class == "exploitable", "known-exploited or EPSS 50%+ finding open", rk_class == "critical", "worst open finding " . rk_top, rk_cves > 0, rk_cves . " open", 1=1, "no open findings") | eval rk_rows = mvappend(rk_portnode . "|port|" . rk_pkg . "|package|" . rk_cves . "|" . rk_pkg_label . "|" . rk_class, if(rk_cves > 0, rk_pkg . "|package|" . rk_cves . " open, worst " . rk_top . " @ " . hostname . " › " . rk_pkg . "|cve|" . rk_cves . "||" . rk_class, null())) | fields rk_rows, rk_portnode, rk_class | mvexpand rk_rows ] | where isnotnull(rk_rows) | eval source = mvindex(split(rk_rows, "|"), 0), source_kind = mvindex(split(rk_rows, "|"), 1), target = mvindex(split(rk_rows, "|"), 2), target_kind = mvindex(split(rk_rows, "|"), 3), value = tonumber(mvindex(split(rk_rows, "|"), 4)), edge_label = mvindex(split(rk_rows, "|"), 5), edge_class = mvindex(split(rk_rows, "|"), 6) | eventstats max(rk_maxhop) AS rk_maxhop | eval rk_maxhop = coalesce(rk_maxhop, 1) | eval rk_pname = case(match(target_kind, ":port$$"), target, source_kind == "port", source, 1=1, null()) | eval rk_phop = if(match(target_kind, ":port$$"), tonumber(replace(target_kind, ":port$$", "")), null()) | eventstats max(rk_phop) AS rk_my_hop BY rk_pname | where source_kind != "port" OR isnotnull(rk_my_hop) | eventstats values(eval(if(source_kind == "port", rk_class, null()))) AS rk_port_class BY rk_pname | eval edge_class = if(match(target_kind, ":port$$") AND isnotnull(rk_port_class), mvindex(rk_port_class, 0), edge_class) | eval source_kind = case(source_kind == "port", coalesce(rk_my_hop, 1) . ":port", source_kind == "package", (rk_maxhop + 1) . ":package", 1=1, source_kind) | eval target_kind = case(target_kind == "package", (rk_maxhop + 1) . ":package", target_kind == "cve", (rk_maxhop + 2) . ":cve", 1=1, target_kind) | stats max(value) AS value, values(edge_label) AS edge_label, values(edge_class) AS edge_class BY source, source_kind, target, target_kind | eval edge_label = mvindex(edge_label, 0), edge_class = mvindex(mvfilter(edge_class != ""), 0) | sort 5000 - value | head 500 | fields source, source_kind, target, target_kind, value, edge_label, edge_class

viz.option: Edges exist, but none from a declared entry point has resolved to a host and port in the inventory. Either no entry point is declared, or the addresses the firewall logged are not ones the inventory has seen a host hold. The Network evidence page's "where the app refused to name a host" panel says which.

div.b: A jump here is a permitted flow the firewall logged, not an exploit path.
div.span: The hop after a compromise needs privilege, credentials or a trust relationship, and a firewall log records none of them. Read the graph as "traffic was allowed and happened between these points", and the last two columns as "and this is what was listening there, with these findings open". Widths are sessions on the left and open CVEs on the right; a thin edge is still a path.

search.query: | inputlookup riskability_findings_state_lookup where status="open" | eval rk_sel = $sel_node|s$, rk_kind = $sel_kind|s$ | eval rk_host_of_port = if(rk_kind == "port", mvindex(split(rk_sel, ":"), 0), null()) | eval rk_port_of_port = if(rk_kind == "port", mvindex(split(rk_sel, ":"), 1), null()) | eval rk_cve_host = if(rk_kind == "cve", trim(mvindex(split(mvindex(split(rk_sel, " @ "), 1), " › "), 0)), null()) | eval rk_cve_pkg = if(rk_kind == "cve", trim(mvindex(split(mvindex(split(rk_sel, " @ "), 1), " › "), 1)), null()) | where case(rk_kind == "host", hostname == rk_sel, rk_kind == "package", package == rk_sel, rk_kind == "cve", hostname == rk_cve_host AND package == rk_cve_pkg, rk_kind == "port", hostname == rk_host_of_port, 1=1, false()) | lookup riskability_exposure_lookup hostname, package OUTPUT port AS rk_ports | where rk_kind != "port" OR mvfind(rk_ports, "^" . rk_port_of_port . "$") >= 0 | join type=left hostname [ | inputlookup riskability_netevidence_lookup | where observed_grade IN ("confirmed observed", "historically observed") | stats values(port) AS rk_observed_ports BY hostname ] | eval rk_port_one = if(rk_kind == "host", rk_ports, "n/a") | mvexpand rk_port_one | eval rk_behind_observed = if(rk_kind != "host", 1, if(isnotnull(rk_observed_ports) AND isnotnull(mvfind(rk_observed_ports, "^" . rk_port_one . "$")), 1, 0)) | where rk_behind_observed == 1 | dedup finding_key | lookup riskability_aiverdicts_lookup cve_id OUTPUT priority_tier, priority_score, recommended_action, rationale | eval Tier = coalesce(priority_tier, "P" . case(severity=="critical", 1, severity=="high", 2, severity=="medium", 3, 1=1, 4)) | eval Score = coalesce(priority_score, ""), KEV = if(isnotnull(kev_added) AND kev_added != "", "yes", "") | eval Fix = coalesce(fixed_version, "") | eval "Why" = coalesce(rationale, "not analysed by the pipeline yet; tier from severity") | sort 0 Tier, - Score | rename hostname AS Host, package AS Software, current_version AS Installed, cve_id AS CVE, severity AS Severity, recommended_action AS Action | table Tier, Score, CVE, Severity, KEV, Host, Software, Installed, Fix, Action, "Why"

viz.option: No open finding sits behind this point. For a host that means nothing open is behind a port traffic was observed to reach; for a port, nothing open on the software listening there.

div.b: Every row is an open finding the app already holds; nothing here is computed from the firewall.
div.span: The route says traffic was permitted to this point. These are the findings that were open on the software listening there, with the pipeline's tier where it has analysed them and a tier from severity where it has not. A host click lists only the findings behind ports traffic was observed to reach, not everything open on the machine. Clicking an entry point narrows the graph to it instead, since an entry point has no findings of its own.

search.query: | inputlookup riskability_netevidence_lookup | search hostname=$host_filter|s$ | where observed_grade IN ("confirmed observed", "historically observed") | eval From = coalesce(entry_text, ""), To = hostname . ":" . port, Kind = "entry point to host" | eval rk_ef = $entry_filter|s$ | where rk_ef == "*" OR From == rk_ef | fields - rk_ef | fields From, To, Kind, observed_grade, sessions, srcs_text, edge_last_seen | append [ | `riskability_fw_edges` | lookup riskability_hostaddr_lookup address AS src_ip OUTPUT hostname AS rk_src_host, claimants AS rk_src_claim | lookup riskability_hostaddr_lookup address AS dest_ip OUTPUT hostname AS rk_dst_host, claimants AS rk_dst_claim | where isnotnull(rk_src_host) AND isnotnull(rk_dst_host) AND rk_src_host != rk_dst_host | where mvcount(rk_src_host) == 1 AND mvcount(rk_dst_host) == 1 | where coalesce(tonumber(rk_src_claim), 1) <= 1 AND coalesce(tonumber(rk_dst_claim), 1) <= 1 | search rk_src_host=$host_filter|s$ OR rk_dst_host=$host_filter|s$ | stats sum(sessions) AS sessions, max(edge_last_seen) AS edge_last_seen, values(src_ip) AS srcs_text BY rk_src_host, rk_dst_host, port | eval From = rk_src_host, To = rk_dst_host . ":" . port, Kind = "host to host", observed_grade = "lateral, permitted" | fields From, To, Kind, observed_grade, sessions, srcs_text, edge_last_seen ] | eval "Last seen" = if(isnotnull(edge_last_seen) AND edge_last_seen != "", strftime(tonumber(edge_last_seen), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), "") | eval Sources = mvjoin(mvdedup(srcs_text), " ") | rename observed_grade AS Grade, sessions AS Sessions | sort - Sessions | table Kind, From, To, Grade, Sessions, Sources, "Last seen"

viz.option: No jump has been observed from a declared entry point, and no permitted host-to-host flow resolved to two inventory hosts.
